nodes.label: portada.jpg — Sports Training Cover Image
nodes.description: Cover/hero image for the DeporteParaTodos sports management application. Shows an outdoor athletic track (red rubberized surface) with three young athletes (students) running/training in black athletic clothing, observed by an instructor/coach standing to the right holding papers/clipboard. Hurdles are visible on the left side of the track. The scene communicates athletic training, coaching supervision, and institutional sports practice — directly reflecting the application's core domain of managing sports courses, groups of athletes (alumnos), and instructors.
visual_elements: Three student athletes running in black uniforms
Outdoor stadium setting with bleachers visible in background
nodes.design_purpose: Hero/cover image for the application landing page or marketing material; establishes sports/athletics brand identity for the platform
